why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Beachside Bliss' professionally managed by Stay on 30a, a luxurious coastal escape just steps from the sugar-white sands and directly across from Ft. Panic beach access. With sweeping views of the Gulf of Mexico and serene Allen Lake, this 6-bedroom, 5.5-bath estate comfortably hosts up to 16 guests, making it the ultimate setting for family gatherings, reunions, or upscale group getaways. Inside, enjoy a sunlit open-concept layout with refined coastal decor, a designer chef’s kitchen with premium finishes, and an expansive dining space perfect for group meals. Luxurious bedrooms offer ensuite baths, smart TVs, and private balconies, while custom bunk rooms create a stylish retreat for younger guests. Outside, your private resort awaits, featuring a resort-style pool, tranquil lakefront dock, gourmet outdoor kitchen, and ample space to unwind. Lounge in the sun, grill fresh seafood, kayak at sunset, or simply savor the breeze with a cocktail in hand. Whether you're here for sun-soaked beach days or serene lakefront evenings, Beachside Bliss sets the scene for an unforgettable 30A vacation. This ocean view property provides incredible amenities and spectacular views, as well as being a prime location for exploring local shops and restaurants. With 8 adult bikes, plus a 6-passenger golf cart, getting around has never been easier. Experience the ultimate relaxation and convenience at Beachside Bliss!
